# miniaudio dependency

Native Win64 builds use miniaudio 0.11.25 as the backend behind the legacy
MilesLib facade. Win32 continues to use the original Miles Sound System.

Place the upstream single-header release here:

    Extern/miniaudio/miniaudio.h

Pinned upstream release:
https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/releases/tag/0.11.25
